# Your Energy Best (Lumaria Energy)

> San Diego solar and home battery company, run by David West. Two things: new solar and batteries with $0 down options, and help for homeowners who already have solar (audits, troubleshooting, repair guidance, adding a battery). Solar and batteries only. We do not offer HVAC, heating or air conditioning services.

Serves San Diego County and Orange County, California. Phone (858) 786-2204 (858-SUN-2204). The customer app for solar owners is lumaria (www.lumaria.energy).

## New solar and batteries
- [Free solar and battery quote](https://yourenergybest.com/quote/): $0 down options for eligible homes (PPA, prepaid lease, CEA Solar Plus with no credit check in CEA cities), plus loan and cash, compared side by side with escalators and dealer fees shown.
- [Compare options](https://yourenergybest.com/options/): how PPA, prepaid, loan, cash and $0 down programs work in 2026, after the homeowner tax credit ended.
- [Home batteries](https://yourenergybest.com/home-battery/): Tesla Powerwall 3, Enphase IQ Battery, FranklinWH; adding a battery to existing solar; SDCP battery rebate ($2,000–$6,000 per battery) and CEA programs.
- [Solar quotes](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-quote/)

## Already have solar
- [Why is my electric bill high if I have solar?](https://yourenergybest.com/high-bill-with-solar/): the seven usual causes on SDG&E, how to check each one, and which fix fits.
- [Why is my solar true-up bill so high?](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-true-up-bill/): Why a solar true-up bill can be so high on SDG&E, how to tell a production problem from higher usage, and how to avoid the next surprise.
- [When does my NEM 1.0 or 2.0 expire?](https://yourenergybest.com/nem-2-expiring/): NEM 1.0 and 2.0 generally last 20 years from Permission to Operate. How to find your date, what the Solar Billing Plan changes, and how to prepare.
- [Can I add a battery to my solar without losing NEM?](https://yourenergybest.com/add-battery-to-existing-solar/): Can you add a battery to existing solar and keep NEM 1.0 or 2.0? What generally keeps your status, what can end it, and when a battery pays in San Diego.
- [My solar installer went out of business. What do I do?](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-installer-out-of-business/): Solar company closed? What happens to your warranties, monitoring, lease or PPA, and how to find licensed help for an orphaned solar system in San Diego.
- [SDG&E Solar Billing Plan (NEM 3.0) explained](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-billing-plan-explained/)
- [SDCP battery rebate: rules and how it works](https://yourenergybest.com/sdcp-battery-rebate/)
- [New roof under solar: remove, reroof, reinstall](https://yourenergybest.com/reroof-with-solar/)
- [Selling a home with solar (owned, leased, PPA)](https://yourenergybest.com/selling-a-home-with-solar/)
- [Solar lease or PPA buyout](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-lease-buyout/)
- [Get your solar monitoring into your own name](https://yourenergybest.com/transfer-solar-monitoring/)
- [Closed solar installers list](https://yourenergybest.com/closed-solar-installers/)
- [SunPower out of business: what owners should do](https://yourenergybest.com/sunpower-out-of-business/)

- [Solar savings audit](https://yourenergybest.com/audit/): production versus what was promised, bills and true-up, rate plan and agreement, from someone who didn't sell the system. See current price on the page.
- [Independent solar inspection](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-inspection/): on-site roof, mounting, wiring, panel, inverter and battery check with a written report.
- [lumaria app](https://www.lumaria.energy/): free for solar owners; shows what a system is really producing and saving.
